title: MiniCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of LLMs on Grounding Documents
authors: Liyan Tang; Philippe Laban; Greg Durrett
why_relevant: Provides an efficient fact-checker and unified benchmark (LLM-AggreFact) for verifying LLM outputs against grounding documents, directly useful for evaluating RAG faithfulness and detecting unsupported claims.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on fact-checking/grounding verification rather than retrieval robustness, conflict, or attacks directly.
